blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Sen. Mark Villar has joined the Senate majority bloc, Majority Leader Juan Miguel Zubiri said on Thursday. Zubiri made the confirmation after the 13-member majority bloc elected Villar as chairman of the Senate committee on public works and a member of the Commission on Appointments (CA).
